normalize_gmock_output: normalize gmock test output by removing headers, footers, locations, memory addresses, and error markers
run_gmock_test_command: run the gmock_output_test_ executable and return normalized output with leaky test names
generate_gmock_golden_file: generate the golden reference file for gmock output test comparison using --gengolden flag
test_gmock_output_match: test that gmock test output matches the expected golden file and verifies leaked mock detection
extract_leaky_test_names: extract test names of leaked mock objects from gmock test output using regex pattern matching
